core.purpose: Everything a model that has never seen iLang needs to read, write, execute and judge it.

sources.layer: communication layer: the two syntaxes, the 88 verbs, modifiers, entities, declarations (v3.0 Final)
execution semantics: input isolation, budget, objective and task lifecycle, rubric, evidence, completion audit (v4.0 Final, current stable)
judgment layer: four axioms, the eleven-dimension vector, the decision modes and reference function, declaration grammar and entity registry (v5.0, public preview)

media.purpose: Optional extension for image, video and audio work.

sources.layer: media profile: image, video and audio vocabulary (v4.1)
media regions, masks and image layers (v4.2)
